new_libraries.name: AERL C Framework
new_libraries.author: Applied Electronics and Robotics Laboratory LLP
new_libraries.sentence: A HAL framework that makes embedded and robotics code fast, simple, and reliable — built for beginners.
new_libraries.paragraph: Beta. One global object (AERL), no setup boilerplate: include it and use it. Non-blocking timing (glow/flash/glctrl), unified logging, run-once/run-N control, and UART/I2C/SPI helpers. Works right beside Arduino.h.

library.name: BACnetMSTP
library.author: George Arun <argeorun@gmail.com>
library.sentence: BACnet MS/TP server library for Arduino - RS-485 fieldbus connectivity.
library.paragraph: Fully hardware-validated BACnet MS/TP server for Arduino. Supports Uno R3, Mega 2560, ESP32, ESP32-S3, STM32 Nucleo-144 F756ZG, and STM32 Blue Pill F103CB (compile-only, not yet hardware-tested). ReadProperty, WriteProperty, Who-Is/I-Am services. EEPROM-backed MAC address, baud rate, and device instance. Single include, 4-line sketch. Derived from https://github.com/argeorun/BACnet-MSTP-Arduino by the same author.

library.name: Lucarne
library.author: Techalchemy
library.sentence: UI toolkit for SPI displays (ST7789, ST7735S) on Arduino and ESP32 — drivers, widgets, and Studio export.
library.paragraph: Lucarne provides standalone SPI display drivers, a lightweight graphics layer, configurable framebuffering, a high-level UI runtime (screens, widgets, menus, transitions, data binding), and Lucarne Studio — a browser editor to design interfaces and export C++ headers. No Adafruit dependency.
